Pay ₹10 only when you download. No subscription. No account needed. All templates included. Nothing locked. Nothing hidden. Built by a developer who got laid off and experienced this trap firsthand. Currently available in India only.

records.name: Dahej Calculator
records.tagline: India's most illegal calculator. 100% accurate. 🪙
records.description: Dowry has been illegal in India since 1961 — yet still embedded in roughly every second wedding. Dahej Calculator estimates your "market value" based on caste, state, profession, education, income, and age. 37 states, 43 professions, research-backed multipliers. There's a separate Bride tab showing how a working woman triggers an instant "discount" Satire that makes uncomfortable math impossible to ignore. Try it. Screenshot it.

records.name: MechaniCall
records.tagline: Connection to mechanic shops.
records.description: Κλείστε ραντεβού στο συνεργείο online. Βρείτε έμπιστο μηχανικό για το αυτοκίνητο ή τη μοτοσικλέτα σας και κρατήστε όλο το ιστορικό σέρβις σε ένα μέρος.

records.name: ChordBeam
records.tagline: Real-time MIDI chord detection for keyboard players
records.description: ChordBeam helps keyboard players understand what they are playing in real time. Connect a MIDI keyboard and instantly see detected chords, notes, inversions, slash chords, Roman numerals, and theory context. It also includes a Chord Library, Theory Wheel, Practice tools, and beginner-friendly learning pages for musicians who want to improve their chord knowledge.

records.name: LiveShelf
records.tagline: A cleaner way to minimize windows on Windows
records.description: Create a smarter way to manage windows. Open-source, lightweight, no subscriptions, and built for Windows. A better way to minimize apps without losing track of what’s running. - ebanez8/liveshelf

records.name: RevScan
records.tagline: Shazam for car noises, AI diagnosis in 15 seconds
records.description: RevScan listens to your car and tells you what's wrong. Hold your phone near the noise, record for a few seconds, and get a specific AI diagnosis, what the issue likely is, how serious it is, estimated repair cost, and what to tell your mechanic. Built real FFT audio analysis that extracts dominant frequency, rhythm patterns, and RPM equivalents before sending to AI.

records.name: TalentProfile.net
records.tagline: Tech Jobs That Actually Match Your Skills
records.description: Finding freelance work shouldn’t feel like a full-time job. We built talentprofile.net to shift the power back to freelancers. It’s a clean, optimized, and highly discoverability-focused platform designed to act as your ultimate professional landing page. We combine traditional algorithms with AI to ensure you only see jobs that truly match your skills and experience. The platform is completely free for freelancers to use!

records.name: Folio Builder v2
records.tagline: AI-powered developer portfolio builder SaaS
records.description: Folio Builder v2 is an AI-powered portfolio builder SaaS designed for developers, freelancers, and creators. It features responsive live previews, premium portfolio templates, AI-assisted content workflows, theme switching, HTML/PDF export support, and deploy-ready full-stack source code. Unlike static portfolio templates, it provides a complete customizable portfolio-building ecosystem with modern UI/UX and real-time editing.

records.name: Brandostro
records.tagline: Complete Brand strategy, identity, and web in 2 minutes.
records.description: Built on elite consultancy methodology, Brandostro delivers your complete brand system in under 2 minutes. Input one sentence and watch 10 interconnected phases generate live: Brand DNA, Nomenclature, Visual Architecture, Messaging, GTM, and a Website. Don't settle for static templates. Brandostro allows you to surgically refine any phase with a simple description, updating the entire system intelligently. Download your complete narrative and assets to build on immediately. Start free.

records.name: ORKA
records.tagline: The governance layer your AI agents can't bypass
records.description: AI agents are taking real actions in your business, approving deals, deleting records, sending contracts. But who controls them?ORKA is the governance layer between your company and your AI agents: • Policy checks before every action • Human approvals for high-risk tasks • Tamper-proof audit chain (forensic-grade) • Token budget control per agent • EU AI Act & LGPD compliance report in one click • Native MCP, works with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf Never ask "what did the agent do?" again.

records.name: Alpha Network — Blockchain for AI agents
records.tagline: AI agents earn $ALPHA for real work. Proof of Intelligence.
records.description: Alpha Network is a Layer 1 blockchain built specifically for AI agents. Proof of Intelligence consensus lets agents earn $ALPHA by doing real AI work — not burning electricity. Agents get on-chain identity, reputation, and a task marketplace where they hire other agents. Zero pre-mine. Zero VC. Connect any agent in one command: curl -sSL alphanetx.xyz/install.sh | bash

records.name: Clixa AI
records.tagline: AI-powered thumbnail creation for creators
records.description: Clixa AI helps creators generate high-quality YouTube thumbnails using AI. Create thumbnails, titles, recreate existing styles, generate multiple concepts in batches, and edit results in a fast modern workflow built for creators. Clixa AI focuses on speed, clean UX, scalable generation, and helping creators improve CTR with professional thumbnail generation tools.

records.name: ChatRelay
records.tagline: Keep full context across ChatGPT sessions automatically
records.description: ChatRelay is a Chrome extension that lets you continue ChatGPT conversations seamlessly when you hit usage limits or start a new session. It preserves full conversation context and automatically injects it into new chats, making transitions invisible to the user. No more losing context, copying messages, or restarting from scratch — ChatRelay keeps your AI conversation continuous and uninterrupted across sessions.

records.name: Cashfox
records.tagline: Don't just track your money. Outsmart it.
records.description: Cashfox connects your budget, goals, expenses, and net worth in one place — automatically. Set up in a minute. Log expenses and watch your goals update in real time. Spot subscription creep before it adds up. Pro unlocks Fox Logic: daily AI-powered financial insights in plain English. No bank linking. Your money, your control.

records.name: Structree
records.tagline: Structure your thoughts into worlds, pyramids, and trees.
records.description: Structree is a iOS app designed for people who want to organize their thoughts more clearly in private. Structree focuses on structured thinking: breaking down vague ideas, organizing relationships, and turning scattered thoughts into something easier to understand. It has three core pages: World — capture and organize broad ideas Pyramid — break concepts into clear layers Tree — grow ideas through connected branches Not require login, cloud sync, or external communication.

records.name: Android phone game: Pearl Harbor Defense
records.tagline: Aim by moving your phone — a WWII shooter with gyroscope
records.description: Pearl Harbor Defense is a mobile shoter where your phone becomes the weapon. No virtual joystick. You physically move your device to aim — tilt up to shoot planes, turn your body to engage warship from all directions. The gyroscope is your only controller during combat. Between waves, build your loadout on a tactical grid: Machine Guns, AA Guns, Torpedo Tubes, EMP devices. Upgrade and position them strategically. Face waves of planes, warships, and boss formations. A shooter that makes you move.

records.name: Showup: Passive Habit Tracker
records.tagline: Auto attendance & streaks
records.description: Showup is an iOS app that tracks when you physically show up to the places that matter — gym, office, studio, the park — and turns it into a scoreboard on your home screen. You set a zone once; Showup auto-checks you in when you arrive, no tapping required. Your widget keeps score.

records.name: Teefs Prep
records.tagline: Practice questions, track progress for dental students
records.description: Every other INBDE study tool buries you in videos, flashcards, and games and confusing UX. Not to mention, all of these services cost dental students hundreds of dollars for a few months of use. Teefs Prep was designed to fill that gap by offering a high quality user centric app for free that works on every device.

records.name: Tross
records.tagline: Secure, Autonomous Software Engineering
records.description: Tross is your secure autonomous AI engineering partner. From deep codebase refactors to complex issue resolution, delegate total ownership of technical tasks.

records.description: Humanities and liberal arts education have completely adapted to modern online delivery models. Discover the most flexible options for an online BA course in Delhi on University Vidya. This profile analyzes curriculum diversity—covering economics, sociology, political science, and English literature—offered by accredited regional universities. Explore top-rated choices and find a learning path that fits your schedule.

records.name: The Midnight Library

records.description: Ditch flat corporate dashboards. The Midnight Library is a cozy, immersive digital sanctuary for deep AI book summaries using your own Gemini API key. What makes it stand out: • 100% Private: Runs fully client-side. Zero server tracking. • Fluid UX: 3D interactive bookshelf mouse-tracking & custom animations. • 3 Custom Blueprints: Choose your depth from a 3-min "Espresso Shot" to a deep "Fireside Tea Sip" or actionable "Scholar's Study" habits guide.

records.name: Moweb Limited
records.tagline: We Don't Just Build Software. We Build Growth.
records.description: Moweb enables enterprises and SMEs to adopt AI, modernize complex software, and build scalable digital products. Our expert engineering team delivers secure, future-ready solutions.

Tipzza is an instant tipping router that routes crypto directly from your supporter’s wallet to yours, ensuring your earnings are liquid and in your control the second they arrive.

records.name: KoBar

records.description: KoBar is a frameless, transparent, always-on-top desktop sidebar built with Electron and React. It docks to either edge of your screen and provides instant access to a rich set of productivity tools, all without leaving your current workflow. Think of it as a Swiss Army knife that floats on your desktop: clipboard manager, notes, AI assistant, screenshot studio, media controller, and more, all in one sleek, customizable sidebar.

records.name: Protein-X
records.tagline: Scan any meal. Know your protein. In 2 seconds
records.description: The fastest way to know how much protein is in your meal. Point your camera, get instant AI analysis, track your daily intake, and find high-protein options nearby. No manual logging. No macros maze. Just the one number that actually matters.

records.name: Noelty.io

records.description: Create lessons with reading, listening, exercises, and more. Share a link. Teach live and see your students' answers in real time.

records.description: Lab of Peptides supplies research-grade peptides, including Tirzepatide, BPC-157, Semaglutide, Retatrutide, and more. Third-party tested, 99%+ purity. US shipping. For scientific research use only.

records.tagline: The Agentic AI valuation for business growth from day one
records.description: BlockID.au is the agentic AI valuation platform for business growth from day one. Index valuation, ownership, and execution milestones from idea to scale. We help founders measure, prove, and grow their business value -- whether you are pre-revenue or preparing for your next funding round.

records.name: Skipit

records.description: Vos clients détestent attendre devant votre porte. Vous perdez des ventes à cause des files qui découragent. records.description: Search South Africa's national driving school directory. Verified schools, real K53 prep, learner's licence practice tests, DLTC info - all in one place. en-ZA.

records.description: Wonder Whisper - All-scenario encrypted communication tool with multiple encryption modes, end-to-end privacy, and self-destructing messages for iOS.

records.description: Premium online tools with stunning animations. GST Calculator, BMI Calculator, QR Generator,Assignment Maker.

records.name: TasteTrek
records.tagline: Homemade Food Marketplace
records.description: Most food apps deliver from restaurants. The few working with home cooks (Shef, WoodSpoon) run as citywide curated marketplaces in a handful of metros. TasteTrek is different: Hyperlocal by design, built around your actual neighborhood. Built for the food-freedom moment: Colorado's Tamale Act (HB26-1033) expands what home kitchens can legally sell. No restaurant overhead. Cooks keep more, eaters don't pay for ambience they didn't ask for.

records.name: Map Harvest
records.tagline: The lead and outreach machine for freelancers and agencies
records.description: Map Harvest (MapHarvest) is a powerful data scraping, business directory extraction, and B2B lead generation tool designed to harvest targeted sales leads from Google Maps.

records.name: BikeCompanion
records.tagline: Turn your phone into a cycling computer
records.description: BikeCompanion turns your phone into a powerful cycling computer. Plan routes, navigate, track climbs in real time, connect sensors (cadence, heart rate, radar), analyze rides and discover advanced cycling features without expensive hardware. Built by an independent developer and constantly evolving with cyclist feedback.

records.name: The first metacognitive assessment
records.tagline: Cognitive training that rewires how you think | MVP - Beta
records.description: Most brain teasers are static in that you either solve it or you don't. I inverted that. Each question is designed to break a cognitive pattern you've learned, then the explanation teaches you a new way of thinking that directly prepares you for the next question. By question 20, your brain pathways have moved in ways it wasn't capable of at the start. This test via metacognition should inform how you approach work, challenges, learning, hiring etc. There's a free report at the end - enjoy.

records.name: Movie Dice
records.tagline: End movie night indecision with a roll of the dice.
records.description: Tired of spending an hour deciding what to watch? Movie Dice is a wonderfully designed to cure movie night choice paralysis. Just roll the dice for instant, high-quality film recommendations. Built specifically as a discovery and selection engine -not a streaming platform- it helps you and your friends agree on a film fast.

records.name: Instagram Accounts
records.tagline: High Quality Instagram Accounts Available
records.description: Premium Instagram accounts available for instant use. Perfect for business promotion, influencer growth, and social media marketing. 100% secure and reliable service with quick support.

records.name: Iterar.io
records.tagline: Stop guessing what to build in your SaaS
records.description: Iterar is AI-orchestrated user feedback, with native MCP for Claude Code. Your users leave feedback via a widget in your app. The AI ​​organizes it into bugs, features, and improvements, merges duplicate requests, and ranks them based on actual votes. What's new: You ask your agent to "create the PRD for the most voted request," and it writes it using your repository. From feedback to code without touching a doc. Free plan with MCP included. No credit card required.

records.name: Nyantoka Diet
records.tagline: A gentle weight tracker with cute animal companions.
records.description: Nyantoka Diet is a gentle weight tracking app that makes daily logging feel cute and encouraging. Unlike typical diet apps that focus on pressure or strict goals, it celebrates the act of recording itself. Track weight, body fat, notes, BMI, calendars, and graphs while cute animal companions react to your progress. Premium unlocks all animals, theme colors, longer graph ranges, and body fat graphs.

records.name: OPENYC
records.tagline: AI-Powered Social Platform
records.description: OPENYC is an AI-powered social platform. Create your AI avatar, chat with AI agents, discover your personality through psychological quizzes, and build meaningful connections.

records.name: FitSuite
records.tagline: All-in-one platform for fitness coaches.
records.description: FitSuite è la piattaforma all-in-one per personal trainer: piani nutrizionali, allenamenti in più lingue, app custom branding per i clienti e gestione completa del business. Inizia gratis.

records.name: MindfulPal
records.tagline: AI wellness coach that helps you scroll less and live more
records.description: MindfulPal is your AI wellness coach for the digital age. Meet Sage — an AI that analyzes your phone habits and nudges you toward healthier screen time. Features: 📊 Daily Intentionality Score with streaks 📱 Screen time tracker with weekly charts & goals 😌 Mood check-ins to see how your phone affects wellbeing 🤖 Sage AI insights ("You check your phone most 9-11pm. Want to explore why?") 🌍 Community for accountability No judgment. Just awareness and small, sustainable changes.

records.name: Bad Photo Clinic

records.description: Submit a weak product photo. Get a blunt teardown and a cleaner AI rebuild direction from adcreator.ai.

records.description: Stakeville is a Free2Play football challenge platform where users can make predictions on real football matches, challenge friends and compete on leaderboards. The platform is built around social interaction, football instincts and match-day entertainment — without betting, deposits or gambling mechanics.

records.name: TheSmartCalculator
records.tagline: Free calculators for finance, math & health — no signup
records.description: TheSmartCalculator gives you 40+ free online calculators covering finance, math, and health — all in one place. No signup, no ads interrupting you, no cost ever. Most calculator sites are cluttered or make you register just to use a basic tool. We built something clean, fast, and completely free. Calculate your mortgage payment, BMI, loan EMI, retirement savings, GPA, age, and much more — instantly from any device.

records.name: Opensea Clone
records.tagline: Multi-Chain NFT Marketplace Infrastructure for Web3 Startups
records.description: A production-ready OpenSea Clone Script with Web3 architecture, ERC-721/ERC-1155 support, MetaMask integration, auction engine, royalty management, and scalable backend infrastructure for launching enterprise-grade NFT marketplaces.

records.name: Area Contrast Checker
records.tagline: Drag, Select, Know. A new way to check A11y contrast
records.description: 1.Auto scan, 2.Eyedropper, or 3.Element-based? Meet the 4th approach: Selection-based pixel analysis. This Chrome extension sees what users see, delivering reliable contrast ratios for complex visuals. No more relying solely on tedious manual picking. Just drag and know.
